name: Source Ledger
summary: Which sources backed the last answer, and were they actually used?
description: Lists the sources attached to the latest stored research answer as a three-column ledger: source, title and whether the answer used it. Reads the same local research store as Research Brief; nothing is fetched to build the ledger.
highlights: Every source behind the latest answer in one table
Title and used flag next to each source
Same stored answer as Research Brief; no refetch
